        COALESCE(p."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) AS plants_count,
        COALESCE(s."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) AS substations_count,
        COALESCE(t."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p", 0) AS transmission_km,
        -- Calculate an energy criticality score
        (COALESCE(p."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) * 0.4 + 
         COALESCE(s."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) * 0.3 + 
         COALESCE(t."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p", 0) * 0.3) AS energy_criticality_score
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" p ON h."hex_id" = p."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s ON h."hex_id" = s."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" t ON h."hex_id" = t."hex_id"
),
critical_infra AS (
    SELECT 
        h."hex_id",
        COALESCE(hosp."hifld_health_hospitals_n", 0) AS hospitals_count,
        COALESCE(fire."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n", 0) AS fire_ems_count,
        COALESCE(law."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n", 0) AS law_enforcement_count,
        COALESCE(eoc."hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n", 0) AS local_eoc_count,
        COALESCE(state_eoc."hifld_state_emergency_operations_centers_n", 0) AS state_eoc_count,
        COALESCE(shelter."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n", 0) AS shelter_count,
        COALESCE(water."hifld_water_wtp_n", 0) AS water_treatment_count,
        COALESCE(roads."hifld_primary_roads_km", 0) AS primary_roads_km,
        -- Calculate an infrastructure criticality score
        (COALESCE(hosp."hifld_health_hospitals_n", 0) * 0.25 +
         COALESCE(fire."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n", 0) * 0.15 +
         COALESCE(law."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n", 0) * 0.10 +
         COALESCE(water."hifld_water_wtp_n", 0) * 0.20 +
         COALESCE(roads."hifld_primary_roads_km", 0) * 0.10 +
         COALESCE(eoc."hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n", 0) * 0.10 +
         COALESCE(shelter."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n", 0) * 0.10) AS infra_criticality_score
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" hosp ON h."hex_id" = hosp."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" fire ON h."hex_id" = fire."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" law ON h."hex_id" = law."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_EOC-N" eoc ON h."hex_id" = eoc."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-STATE_EOC-N" state_eoc ON h."hex_id" = state_eoc."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" shelter ON h."hex_id" = shelter."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-WATER-WTP-N" water ON h."hex_id" = water."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-TRANSP-PRIMARY_RD-L" roads ON h."hex_id" = roads."hex_id"
),
population_data AS (
    SELECT 
        h."hex_id",
        COALESCE(pop."population_7km", 0) AS population,
        COALESCE(bld."building_count", 0) AS building_count,
        COALESCE(vul."sovi", 0) AS social_vulnerability,
        COALESCE(vul2."nri_eal", 0) AS expected_annual_loss,
        COALESCE(vul4."psvi_score", 0) AS pandemic_vulnerability,
        COALESCE(cri."nri_cri_value", 0) AS community_risk_index
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
    LEFT JOIN "EX_POP_001" pop ON h."hex_id" = pop."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "EX_BLD_001" bld ON h."hex_id" = bld."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" vul ON h."hex_id" = vul."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_003" vul2 ON h."hex_id" = vul2."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_004" vul4 ON h."hex_id" = vul4."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "CR_001" cri ON h."hex_id" = cri."hex_id"
),
combined_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        h."hex_id",
        h."County",
        h."State",
        h."Zipcode",
        e.energy_criticality_score,
        i.infra_criticality_score,
        p.population,
        p.building_count,
        p.social_vulnerability,
        p.expected_annual_loss,
        p.pandemic_vulnerability,
        p.community_risk_index,
        -- Calculate cascade failure vulnerability score
        -- Weighted combination of energy dependency, infrastructure criticality, and population vulnerability
        (e.energy_criticality_score * 0.35 +
         i.infra_criticality_score * 0.30 +
         (p.population / NULLIF(MAX(p.population) OVER (), 0)) * 0.15 +
         (p.social_vulnerability / NULLIF(MAX(p.social_vulnerability) OVER (), 0)) * 0.10 +
         (p.expected_annual_loss / NULLIF(MAX(p.expected_annual_loss) OVER (), 0)) * 0.10) AS cascade_vulnerability_score
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
    LEFT JOIN energy_critical e ON h."hex_id" = e."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN critical_infra i ON h."hex_id" = i."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN population_data p ON h."hex_id" = p."hex_id"
    WHERE e.energy_criticality_score > 0 OR i.infra_criticality_score > 0 OR p.population > 0
)
SELECT 
    "hex_id",
    "County",
    "State",
    "Zipcode",
    ROUND(energy_criticality_score, 4) AS energy_criticality_score,
    ROUND(infra_criticality_score, 4) AS infra_criticality_score,
    population,
    building_count,
    ROUND(social_vulnerability, 4) AS social_vulnerability,
    ROUND(expected_annual_loss, 4) AS expected_annual_loss,
    ROUND(pandemic_vulnerability, 4) AS pandemic_vulnerability,
    ROUND(community_risk_index, 4) AS community_risk_index,
    ROUND(cascade_vulnerability_score, 4) AS cascade_vulnerability_score,
    -- Rank by cascade vulnerability
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cascade_vulnerability_score DESC) AS cascade_risk_rank
FROM combined_scores
WHERE cascade_vulnerability_score > 0
ORDER BY cascade_vulnerability_score DESC
LIMIT 100;

cases.question: A comprehensive statewide compound-disaster event is in progress. Define the maximum-credible compound scenario and recommend top resilience investments across affected regions.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH normalized_risks AS (
    SELECT 
        h."hex_id",
        h."County",
        h."State",
        -- Hurricane risk (combining strike rate and wind exposure)
        COALESCE((h1."hurr_strike_rate_10y" - MIN(h1."hurr_strike_rate_10y") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(h1."hurr_strike_rate_10y") OVER() - MIN(h1."hurr_strike_rate_10y") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_hurricane_rate,
        COALESCE((h2."ve_ae_fraction" - MIN(h2."ve_ae_fraction") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(h2."ve_ae_fraction") OVER() - MIN(h2."ve_ae_fraction") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_wind_exposure,
        
        -- Flood risk (coastal + riverine)
        COALESCE((COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0) - MIN(COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) OVER() - MIN(COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_flood,
        
        -- Tornado risk
        COALESCE((t."nri_tornado" - MIN(t."nri_tornado") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(t."nri_tornado") OVER() - MIN(t."nri_tornado") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_tornado,
        
        -- Wildfire risk
        COALESCE((w."crown_fire_prob" - MIN(w."crown_fire_prob") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(w."crown_fire_prob") OVER() - MIN(w."crown_fire_prob") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_wildfire,
        
        -- Social vulnerability
        COALESCE((v2."sovi" - MIN(v2."sovi") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(v2."sovi") OVER() - MIN(v2."sovi") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_sovi,
        COALESCE((v4."psvi_score" - MIN(v4."psvi_score") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(v4."psvi_score") OVER() - MIN(v4."psvi_score") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_psvi,
        
        -- Critical infrastructure exposure
        COALESCE((COALESCE(e1."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e2."hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e3."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e4."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e5."hifld_state_emergency_operations_centers_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e6."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e7."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e8."hifld_health_hospitals_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e9."hifld_water_wtp_n", 0)) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(COALESCE(e1."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e2."hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e3."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e4."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e5."hifld_state_emergency_operations_centers_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e6."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e7."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e8."hifld_health_hospitals_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e9."hifld_water_wtp_n", 0)) OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_crit_infra,
        
        -- Population exposure
        COALESCE((p."population_7km" - MIN(p."population_7km") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(p."population_7km") OVER() - MIN(p."population_7km") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_population,
        
        -- Building exposure
        COALESCE((b."building_count" - MIN(b."building_count") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(b."building_count") OVER() - MIN(b."building_count") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_buildings,
        
        -- Economic exposure (inverse of median income = higher vulnerability)
        COALESCE((v1."inv_median_income" - MIN(v1."inv_median_income") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(v1."inv_median_income") OVER() - MIN(v1."inv_median_income") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_econ_vuln
        
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
    LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_001" h1 ON h."hex_id" = h1."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_002" h2 ON h."hex_id" = h2."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON h."hex_id" = f."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HP_TOR_001" t ON h."hex_id" = t."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "crown_fire_probability" w ON h."hex_id" = w."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v2 ON h."hex_id" = v2."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_004" v4 ON h."hex_id" = v4."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_001" v1 ON h."hex_id" = v1."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "EX_POP_001" p ON h."hex_id" = p."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "EX_BLD_001" b ON h."hex_id" = b."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" e1 ON h."hex_id" = e1."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_EOC-N" e2 ON h."hex_id" = e2."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" e3 ON h."hex_id" = e3."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" e4 ON h."hex_id" = e4."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-STATE_EOC-N" e5 ON h."hex_id" = e5."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e6 ON h."hex_id" = e6."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e7 ON h."hex_id" = e7."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" e8 ON h."hex_id" = e8."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-WATER-WTP-N" e9 ON h."hex_id" = e9."hex_id"
    WHERE h."State" IS NOT NULL
),
compound_risk_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        "hex_id",
        "County",
        "State",
        -- Weighted compound risk score (weights sum to 1)
        -- Higher weights for hazards that drive compound impacts
        (0.20 * ("norm_hurricane_rate" + "norm_wind_exposure") / 2) +  -- Hurricane risk
        (0.20 * "norm_flood") +  -- Flood risk (often compounds with hurricanes)
        (0.15 * "norm_tornado") +  -- Tornado risk
        (0.10 * "norm_wildfire") +  -- Wildfire risk
        (0.15 * ("norm_sovi" + "norm_psvi") / 2) +  -- Social vulnerability
        (0.10 * "norm_crit_infra") +  -- Critical infrastructure exposure
        (0.05 * "norm_population") +  -- Population exposure
        (0.03 * "norm_buildings") +  -- Building exposure
        (0.02 * "norm_econ_vuln") AS compound_risk_score
    FROM normalized_risks
),
county_aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        "County",
        "State",
        COUNT(*) AS hex_count,
        AVG(compound_risk_score) AS avg_compound_risk,
        MAX(compound_risk_score) AS max_compound_risk,
        SUM(compound_risk_score) AS total_compound_risk,
        -- Identify risk hotspots (percentage of high-risk hexagons)
        SUM(CASE WHEN compound_risk_score > 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_high_risk_hexagons
    FROM compound_risk_scores
    WHERE "County" IS NOT NULL AND "State" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY "County", "State"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5  -- Reduced threshold to ensure we get results
),
investment_priorities AS (
    SELECT 
        "County",
        "State",
        "avg_compound_risk",
        "max_compound_risk",
        "total_compound_risk",
        "pct_high_risk_hexagons",
        -- Investment priority score (higher = more urgent)
        (0.4 * "avg_compound_risk" + 
         0.3 * "max_compound_risk" + 
         0.3 * ("pct_high_risk_hexagons" / 100.0)) AS investment_priority_score,
        -- Investment recommendations based on risk profile
        CASE 
            WHEN "avg_compound_risk" > 0.7 OR "pct_high_risk_hexagons" > 50 THEN 'CRITICAL: Multi-hazard resilience investments needed'
            WHEN "avg_compound_risk" > 0.5 OR "pct_high_risk_hexagons" > 30 THEN 'HIGH: Targeted resilience investments recommended'
            WHEN "avg_compound_risk" > 0.3 OR "pct_high_risk_hexagons" > 15 THEN 'MODERATE: Selective investments advised'
            ELSE 'LOW: Maintain current resilience measures'
        END AS investment_urgency,
        CASE 
            WHEN "max_compound_risk" > 0.8 THEN 'Focus on critical infrastructure hardening and emergency response capacity'
            WHEN "max_compound_risk" > 0.6 THEN 'Enhance community shelters and evacuation routes'
            ELSE 'Improve early warning systems and community preparedness'
        END AS recommended_actions
    FROM county_aggregates
)
SELECT 
    "County",
    "State",
    ROUND("avg_compound_risk", 4) AS avg_compound_risk,
    ROUND("max_compound_risk", 4) AS max_compound_risk,
    ROUND("total_compound_risk", 4) AS total_compound_risk,
    ROUND("pct_high_risk_hexagons", 2) AS pct_high_risk_hexagons,
    ROUND("investment_priority_score", 4) AS investment_priority_score,
    "investment_urgency",
    "recommended_actions"
FROM investment_priorities
WHERE "avg_compound_risk" > 0.1  -- Lower threshold to ensure we get results
ORDER BY "investment_priority_score" DESC, "avg_compound_risk" DESC, "max_compound_risk" DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

WITH normalized_risks AS (
    SELECT 
        h."hex_id",
        h."County",
        h."State",
        -- Hurricane risk (combining strike rate and wind exposure)
        COALESCE((h1."hurr_strike_rate_10y" - MIN(h1."hurr_strike_rate_10y") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(h1."hurr_strike_rate_10y") OVER() - MIN(h1."hurr_strike_rate_10y") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_hurricane_rate,
        COALESCE((h2."ve_ae_fraction" - MIN(h2."ve_ae_fraction") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(h2."ve_ae_fraction") OVER() - MIN(h2."ve_ae_fraction") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_wind_exposure,
        
        -- Flood risk (coastal + riverine)
        COALESCE((COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0) - MIN(COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) OVER() - MIN(COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_flood,
        
        -- Tornado risk
        COALESCE((t."nri_tornado" - MIN(t."nri_tornado") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(t."nri_tornado") OVER() - MIN(t."nri_tornado") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_tornado,
        
        -- Wildfire risk
        COALESCE((w."crown_fire_prob" - MIN(w."crown_fire_prob") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(w."crown_fire_prob") OVER() - MIN(w."crown_fire_prob") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_wildfire,
        
        -- Social vulnerability
        COALESCE((v2."sovi" - MIN(v2."sovi") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(v2."sovi") OVER() - MIN(v2."sovi") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_sovi,
        COALESCE((v4."psvi_score" - MIN(v4."psvi_score") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(v4."psvi_score") OVER() - MIN(v4."psvi_score") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_psvi,
        
        -- Critical infrastructure exposure
        COALESCE((COALESCE(e1."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e2."hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e3."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e4."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e5."hifld_state_emergency_operations_centers_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e6."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e7."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e8."hifld_health_hospitals_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e9."hifld_water_wtp_n", 0)) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(COALESCE(e1."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e2."hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e3."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e4."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e5."hifld_state_emergency_operations_centers_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e6."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e7."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e8."hifld_health_hospitals_n", 0) + 
                  COALESCE(e9."hifld_water_wtp_n", 0)) OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_crit_infra,
        
        -- Population exposure
        COALESCE((p."population_7km" - MIN(p."population_7km") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(p."population_7km") OVER() - MIN(p."population_7km") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_population,
        
        -- Building exposure
        COALESCE((b."building_count" - MIN(b."building_count") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(b."building_count") OVER() - MIN(b."building_count") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_buildings,
        
        -- Economic exposure (inverse of median income = higher vulnerability)
        COALESCE((v1."inv_median_income" - MIN(v1."inv_median_income") OVER()) / 
                 NULLIF(MAX(v1."inv_median_income") OVER() - MIN(v1."inv_median_income") OVER(), 0), 0) AS norm_econ_vuln
        
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
    LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_001" h1 ON h."hex_id" = h1."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_002" h2 ON h."hex_id" = h2."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON h."hex_id" = f."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HP_TOR_001" t ON h."hex_id" = t."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "crown_fire_probability" w ON h."hex_id" = w."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v2 ON h."hex_id" = v2."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_004" v4 ON h."hex_id" = v4."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_001" v1 ON h."hex_id" = v1."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "EX_POP_001" p ON h."hex_id" = p."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "EX_BLD_001" b ON h."hex_id" = b."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" e1 ON h."hex_id" = e1."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_EOC-N" e2 ON h."hex_id" = e2."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" e3 ON h."hex_id" = e3."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" e4 ON h."hex_id" = e4."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-STATE_EOC-N" e5 ON h."hex_id" = e5."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e6 ON h."hex_id" = e6."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e7 ON h."hex_id" = e7."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" e8 ON h."hex_id" = e8."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-WATER-WTP-N" e9 ON h."hex_id" = e9."hex_id"
    WHERE h."State" IS NOT NULL
),
compound_risk_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        "hex_id",
        "County",
        "State",
        -- Weighted compound risk score (weights sum to 1)
        -- Higher weights for hazards that drive compound impacts
        (0.20 * ("norm_hurricane_rate" + "norm_wind_exposure") / 2) +  -- Hurricane risk
        (0.20 * "norm_flood") +  -- Flood risk (often compounds with hurricanes)
        (0.15 * "norm_tornado") +  -- Tornado risk
        (0.10 * "norm_wildfire") +  -- Wildfire risk
        (0.15 * ("norm_sovi" + "norm_psvi") / 2) +  -- Social vulnerability
        (0.10 * "norm_crit_infra") +  -- Critical infrastructure exposure
        (0.05 * "norm_population") +  -- Population exposure
        (0.03 * "norm_buildings") +  -- Building exposure
        (0.02 * "norm_econ_vuln") AS compound_risk_score
    FROM normalized_risks
),
county_aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        "County",
        "State",
        COUNT(*) AS hex_count,
        AVG(compound_risk_score) AS avg_compound_risk,
        MAX(compound_risk_score) AS max_compound_risk,
        SUM(compound_risk_score) AS total_compound_risk,
        -- Identify risk hotspots (percentage of high-risk hexagons)
        SUM(CASE WHEN compound_risk_score > 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_high_risk_hexagons
    FROM compound_risk_scores
    WHERE "County" IS NOT NULL AND "State" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY "County", "State"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5  -- Reduced threshold to ensure we get results
),
investment_priorities AS (
    SELECT 
        "County",
        "State",
        "avg_compound_risk",
        "max_compound_risk",
        "total_compound_risk",
        "pct_high_risk_hexagons",
        -- Investment priority score (higher = more urgent)
        (0.4 * "avg_compound_risk" + 
         0.3 * "max_compound_risk" + 
         0.3 * ("pct_high_risk_hexagons" / 100.0)) AS investment_priority_score,
        -- Investment recommendations based on risk profile
        CASE 
            WHEN "avg_compound_risk" > 0.7 OR "pct_high_risk_hexagons" > 50 THEN 'CRITICAL: Multi-hazard resilience investments needed'
            WHEN "avg_compound_risk" > 0.5 OR "pct_high_risk_hexagons" > 30 THEN 'HIGH: Targeted resilience investments recommended'
            WHEN "avg_compound_risk" > 0.3 OR "pct_high_risk_hexagons" > 15 THEN 'MODERATE: Selective investments advised'
            ELSE 'LOW: Maintain current resilience measures'
        END AS investment_urgency,
        CASE 
            WHEN "max_compound_risk" > 0.8 THEN 'Focus on critical infrastructure hardening and emergency response capacity'
            WHEN "max_compound_risk" > 0.6 THEN 'Enhance community shelters and evacuation routes'
            ELSE 'Improve early warning systems and community preparedness'
        END AS recommended_actions
    FROM county_aggregates
)
SELECT 
    "County",
    "State",
    ROUND("avg_compound_risk", 4) AS avg_compound_risk,
    ROUND("max_compound_risk", 4) AS max_compound_risk,
    ROUND("total_compound_risk", 4) AS total_compound_risk,
    ROUND("pct_high_risk_hexagons", 2) AS pct_high_risk_hexagons,
    ROUND("investment_priority_score", 4) AS investment_priority_score,
    "investment_urgency",
    "recommended_actions"
FROM investment_priorities
WHERE "avg_compound_risk" > 0.1  -- Lower threshold to ensure we get results
ORDER BY "investment_priority_score" DESC, "avg_compound_risk" DESC, "max_compound_risk" DESC
LIMIT 20;
